div.div: لَزِجٌ (S, M, Msb) and ↓ مُتَلَزِّجٌ (M), A thing stretching out, in a neut. sense: roping; or drawing out, with a viscous, glutinous, clammy, cohesive, sticky, or slimy, continuity of parts: syn. مُتَمَطِّطٌ and مُتَمَدِّدٌ: (S:) viscous, glutinous, clammy, cohesive, sticky, ropy, or slimy, so as to adhere to the hand or the like: (Msb:) بَلْغَمٌ لَزِجٌ [Viscous, glutinous, cohesive, sticky, or ropy, phlegm]. (TA.) زَبِيبَةٌ لَزِجَةٌ A sticky raisin. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
